SELECT time, metric, "Calls" FROM (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(c.datetimeorigination, '1h') AS time,
    'Total' AS metric,
    count(*) AS "Calls"
  FROM cdr c
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.datetimeorigination)
    AND (
      '__all__' = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ','))
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM label_rules lr
        WHERE lr.label = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ',')) AND lr.enabled
          AND (
            (lr.fields ? 'calling' AND c.callingpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'called' AND c.finalcalledpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'origDevice' AND c.origdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'destDevice' AND c.destdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
          )
      )
    )
  GROUP BY 1

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(c.datetimeorigination, '1h') AS time,
    lr.label AS metric,
    count(*) AS "Calls"
  FROM cdr c
  JOIN label_rules lr ON lr.enabled AND lr.label = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ','))
    AND (
      (lr.fields ? 'calling' AND c.callingpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
      OR (lr.fields ? 'called' AND c.finalcalledpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
      OR (lr.fields ? 'origDevice' AND c.origdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
      OR (lr.fields ? 'destDevice' AND c.destdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
    )
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.datetimeorigination)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) x
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  round(

FROM cdr c
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.datetimeorigination)

SELECT
  c.finalcalledpartynumber AS "Destination",
  count(*) AS "Calls"
FROM cdr c
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.datetimeorigination)
  AND c.finalcalledpartynumber IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    '__all__' = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ','))
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM label_rules lr
      WHERE lr.label = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ',')) AND lr.enabled
        AND (
          (lr.fields ? 'calling' AND c.callingpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
          OR (lr.fields ? 'called' AND c.finalcalledpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)

ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(c.datetimeorigination, '1h') AS time,
  avg(m.moslqk) AS "Avg MOS"
FROM cdr c
JOIN cmr m ON m.globalcallid_callmanagerid = c.globalcallid_callmanagerid AND m.globalcallid_callid = c.globalcallid_callid
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.datetimeorigination)
  AND m.numberpacketssent >= 50 AND m.moslqk > 0
  AND (
    '__all__' = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ','))
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM label_rules lr
      WHERE lr.label = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ',')) AND lr.enabled
        AND (
          (lr.fields ? 'calling' AND c.callingpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
          OR (lr.fields ? 'called' AND c.finalcalledpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
          OR (lr.fields ? 'origDevice' AND c.origdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
          OR (lr.fields ? 'destDevice' AND c.destdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
        )
    )
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT codec AS "Codec", count(*) AS "Calls"
FROM (
  SELECT c.origcodec AS codec
  FROM cdr_augmented c
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.datetimeorigination)
    AND (
      '__all__' = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ','))
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM label_rules lr
        WHERE lr.label = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ',')) AND lr.enabled
          AND (
            (lr.fields ? 'calling' AND c.callingpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'called' AND c.finalcalledpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'origDevice' AND c.origdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'destDevice' AND c.destdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
          )
      )
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.destcodec AS codec
  FROM cdr_augmented c
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.datetimeorigination)
    AND (
      '__all__' = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ','))
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM label_rules lr
        WHERE lr.label = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ',')) AND lr.enabled
          AND (
            (lr.fields ? 'calling' AND c.callingpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'called' AND c.finalcalledpartynumber ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'origDevice' AND c.origdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
            OR (lr.fields ? 'destDevice' AND c.destdevicename ~* lr.pattern)
          )
      )
    )
) x
WHERE codec IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ca.localdevicename AS "Device", ca.remotedevicename AS "Remote Device", ca.datetimestamp AS "Time", ca.moslqk AS "MOS", ca.jitter AS "Jitter", ca.latency AS "Latency"
FROM cmr_augmented ca
WHERE $__timeFilter(ca.datetimestamp)
  AND (
    '__all__' = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ','))
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM label_rules lr
      WHERE lr.label = ANY(string_to_array('${label:csv}', ',')) AND lr.enabled
        AND (lr.fields ? 'origDevice' OR lr.fields ? 'destDevice')
        AND (ca.localdevicename ~* lr.pattern OR ca.remotedevicename ~* lr.pattern)
    )
  )
ORDER BY ca.datetimestamp DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT ar.name AS "Name", ar.type AS "Type", ar.lookback AS "Window", ar.threshold AS "Threshold", ar.direction AS "Direction", ar.metric AS "Metric", lr.label AS "Label Scope", ar.enabled AS "Enabled"
FROM alert_rules ar
LEFT JOIN label_rules lr ON lr.id = ar.label_id
ORDER BY ar.type

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(c.datetimeorigination, '1h') AS time,
  count(*) AS "Long Calls"
FROM cdr c
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.datetimeorigination)
  AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM c.duration) > (SELECT threshold FROM alert_rules WHERE type = 'long_call' AND enabled ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', c.datetimeorigination) AS hour, count(*) AS calls
  FROM cdr c
  WHERE c.datetimeorigination >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '1 hour'
    AND c.datetimeorigination <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  hour AS time,
  round((calls::numeric / NULLIF(lag(calls) OVER (ORDER BY hour), 0)), 2) AS "Ratio vs Prior Hour"
FROM hourly
WHERE hour >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
ORDER BY hour
